prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity component and interaction state study for the built-in read-only file inspector in TanStack Coding Starter. Reference image supplies existing typography, neutral charcoal surfaces, quiet icon controls and restrained warm accent only; do not copy its empty conversation or session content. This is an extension of that developer workspace, not a new visual identity. Show one large expanded desktop file viewer with a compact searchable folder/file navigator beside a generous source reading pane for src/greet.ts. Source has real-looking line numbers, a quiet file path header, find-in-file matches, wrap and copy icons, and expand/close controls. Below show smaller component studies for rendered README.md with Source/Preview choice, a compact sidebar reader with Back to files, a narrow mobile reader, and concise empty/loading/unavailable-file states with retry. Include both light and dark treatments. No enclosing cards, decorative rules, gradients, branding, model identifiers, or fake status metadata. Manrope interface and IBM Plex Mono source. Keep controls readable and purposeful, with visible keyboard focus. This is a design study board, not product evidence; labels outside the screen samples can identify each state.
role: Code-led component/state study; not a screenshot or approved pixel specification
